manifestoClose: Learn what Bitcoin actually is. Learn it well. Then go run a node.
nodeWhyBody: Bitcoin is a peer-to-peer network of nodes that agree on the truth by running the same code on independent hardware. The only way to know what's actually on the chain is to ask a node. You can run one yourself - and you should.

journeyAside: If you only want the hard questions, chapter 3 stands on its own. If you already hold bitcoin and want to keep it well, start at chapter 5. The order is the recommendation; it isn't a requirement.

glossaryIndexDescription: Bitcoin terms explained honestly, in plain language. Each entry starts with a short definition, then the mechanics, the tradeoffs and where to go deeper.
rabbitHolesIndexDescription: Pick a rabbit hole. Each one is a self-contained, opinionated deep-dive on a single Bitcoin concept - interactive where it matters, sourced everywhere.
journeyIndexDescription: Seven short chapters for someone starting from nothing. A few minutes of reading each, then something you do yourself. No account, nothing to buy, nobody selling anything.
doItNote: Opens LearnBitcoin's practice wallet in this tab. No account, no email, no money: its coins are worth nothing.
doItBack: To come back, press "Back to the chapter" in the wallet. It brings you back here and, once this step is done, marks this card done. Your browser's Back button marks nothing.
doItClearConfirm: Clear all reading progress saved in this browser? This removes the read marks on Journey chapters and rabbit holes, your checklist ticks, and the done marks on your "Do it" steps.
